content: SSE LLM streaming: mid-stream failure after N tokens is non-idempotent (input tokens billed, partial output committed); errors after HTTP 200 must be in-stream events; client must distinguish dropped connection from completed stream or partial output silently looks complete; no authoritative industry pattern for provider-side mid-stream retry — accept partial in UI, retry-from-scratch in pipelines. Cache key must include prompt version + model id.
